notes.title: Hotfix: Projectiles Added & Bugged Tree Lighting In Map Mods
notes.notes:
First I want to take the time to thank all the modders working hard on maps and characters.  We always look forward to seeing what you guys and girls come up with!  We are going to start featuring mods in battle videos on our Youtube channel very soon, so stay tuned!


Changes:
-Fixed some rending glitches when it came to Unity tree sprites in modded maps.  Trees in the distance did not correctly interact with fog and lighting, and also bugged out in water.  
-We added laser arrows and with witches spell to projectiles.


Hope everyone has a great weekend!  Modders keep up the great work!

notes.title: Now Live! Map Modding & Huge Update! - Version 1.5
notes.notes:
The day has finally arrived! This is one of the largest updates we have done since release.  Below is a list of the new content and features in UEBS2!

Note to mod creators.  A tutorial has been added for map modding: https://steamcommunity.com/workshop/discussions/18446744073709551615/600771622034502381/?appid=1468720

New Content And Features:

-Map modding now live on Steam workshop!

-2 in house made maps included in workshop.

-1 new official new map 'Old West'. (Total of 3 new maps).

-New campaign D-Day added to campaigns.

-New god power 'Breath Of God'.

-2 new Alien units added to 'Science Fiction'.

Additional Hotfix Friday: Difficulty reduced slightly in new D-Day campaign.


Known issues with map mods:
-Modded terrains do no show blood spatters.(Fluid volues still show though)



We hope you enjoy this update!  Have a fanctastic week/weekend everyone!

notes.title: Critical Bug Fixes And Code Changes - V 1.3.5
notes.notes:
Hello everyone and Merry Christmas!  We have a patch here for the holidays.  Note that post new year will be a large content update.  We wanted to get this patch out for the holidays since some pretty critical bugs have been fixed.


-Critical bug fixed which caused units to disappear when using multiple armies of the same mod unit in one battle.
-Another critical bug fixed which caused GPU memory leaks when exiting back to main menu after battle.  Often GPU memory remained after  battle, this was a combination of chain reaction errors and a Unity engine bug.
-Big improvements to hit boxes when fighting as a possessed unit.
-Added inverse kinematics to more units for first person.


Merry Christmas everyone!  We will see you all in the new year for a large content update! 

Regards,

Brilliant Game Studios.

notes.title: V1.3 - Volcanic Island Map, 7 New Units, Modding Fixes/Changes & Halloween!
notes.notes:
Version 1.3 has finally arrived!  As some of you may know, we were working very hard on completing our last title The Black Masses, which added significant delays to UEBS2 updates.  That said, we are pleased to announce that nearly every member of the team is back full time on UEBS2, so expect lots of updates to come!  Ps, though this update is fairly significant, larger updates are on the horizon with the team back on UEBS2, we will post a new road map soon.

New Content(All new characters are modeled in house):

-New 'Volcanic Island' map.  A very large volcanic island.  Rock and ash, with huge verticality! 
-New 'Gwyn' hero.  A mythical black magic god from the under world.  He is a character from our 'Black Masses' universe.  He fires a new unique 'black magic' projectile.
-2 new WW1 units.  British and German soldiers(New WW1 category).
-Frankenstein unit added to 'Evil' category for Halloween!
-Zeus god added to Heroes.  
-New 'Space Soldier' who fires new laser projectile.
-New Squidman added to Heroes.
-Added new projectiles to custom units and modded(Black magic & lasers green/red)
-Ranged units now have target motion prediction.  Ai will aim in front of moving targets to predict their motion.
-'Projectile speed' setting added to unit customization.
-Added new 'weight' settings to character modding.  This setting affects physics.  Setting a heavy weight makes it more difficult for character to be thrown.

Fixes:
-Fixed ambient light bug that happened in some maps.
-Other lighting issues fixed such as better bounce light color approx.
-Projectiles can now leave particle trails.  This is featured in the new 'dark magic' projectile, as  well as artillery.
-Bug fixed where animations glitch out for none strafing ranged units while firing.
-Fixed bug that caused some distant low poly characters to have incorrect textures. (mostly noticeable with characters mods)
-Huge fixes with rendering issues that happened with some modded characters(Often distant characters would not render at all, or would be very small in size).

Here is a link to the updated modding tools, which have also updated in the 'tutorials' thread: https://drive.google.com/file/d/18f4KCc8bVak-lttUlciyaV2nneqMULPK/view?usp=drive_link

Afternoon Hotfix:
-Fixed issues with new Frankenstein unit had rendering issues when far away.
-Fixed issue where arrow projectile weighed a huge amount, causing armor to not deflect/block.
-Fixed custom unit saving issues that caused "Max range block force" and "Max range armor force" were not saving.
-Fixed bug that caused all weapons to be unlocked at start of FPS invasion campaign.

Known issues:
-Working hard on a bug that has been around for a while.  Bug that causes modded units to sometimes not work at all when there are multiple army clones of them.

We hope everyone has a fantastic weekend!

notes.title: Next Update Drops Oct 25th! (And what we've been up to)
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

We’re excited to announce that a content update for Ultimate Epic Battle Simulator 2 (UEBS2) will be coming on October 25th! We’ve been working on some exciting new features, and we can’t wait to share them with you.

First, we want to apologize for the recent silence and lack of updates. We value transparency, so here’s what's been going on: while some of the team continued to work on UEBS2, most of us were busy completing our previous title, The Black Masses. For those unfamiliar, we promised our community that after running out of funding, we would return to finish The Black Masses once UEBS2 was complete.

Today, we’re happy to announce that version 1.0 of The Black Masses is officially released! With that done, our full team is now back on UEBS2 development, and we’re eager to move forward. We truly appreciate your patience and ongoing support.

If you're interested in supporting us further and exploring our open-world game, The Black Masses, you can check it out:

 https://store.steampowered.com/app/992910/The_Black_Masses/

Trailer: 

[previewyoutube=gffnc2McP-M;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]



Kind regards,
Brilliant Game Studios.

notes.title: Version 1.1 - Halloween Content, Auto Cinematic, Flashing Flooding And More!
notes.notes:
Hello keyboard generals!  We have a special update for you!  Below is a list of the content and features in this spooky update!


-New spooky graveyard swamp map.

-Flash flooding and rain added to weather system.

-Auto cinematic mode finally in!  Press 'C' to sit back and watch the battle in procedurally generated cinematic shots that attempt to cover all import angles of the battle with epic photography.

-New witch unit added to 'evil', with new spell casting attack.

-New 'Ball Man' added to heroes.  Those red balls are stronger than they look!

-Water shading on terrain improved.  Volumetric water now has micro details within terrain shading, including small puddles and streams.

-Removed 'sliding effect' when performing charge attack in possession mode. 

-Fixed issues where first person had camera placement issues with unusual characters such as 'Gunman'.

-Improved animation crossfading to reduce twitchiness when rapidly swapping animations.


 

 Happy sugar coma's everyone!  Brilliant Game Studios team.

notes.title: Out Now!! Full Release Version 1.0.
notes.notes:
Full release has arrived!  Below we will list the new content in this huge update.  
PS: Road map will be updated soon, there will be lots of other exciting things in store post 1.0!

-New Map 'Modern City'.  A large full scale modern city perfect for your modern day battles!

-New Jungle map.  Get those troops nice and sweaty!

-New battle load out feature.  Save and load infinite battle load outs!

-New time of day system. Weather and time of day can be chosen for battles, as well time can be "frozen".

-Improved animation systems for possession.  Inverse kinematics on weapon holding, hip movement for turning and facing target directions. (Note: not all characters are fully utilizing the new system yet).

-New Hero William Wallace, one of the best tank hero units. (Developed and modelled in house)

-New hero unit Annie Oakley.  The sharpest shooter in the west! (Developed and modelled in house)

-New gunman unit. (Developed and modelled in house).

-Water bug fixed where surface would flash and 'z-fight'.

I hope everyone is having a fantastic summer!  Thank you all for your amazing support during early access!

notes.title: Patch v0.9.1 Fixes For Mods
notes.notes:
Edit:  Some are still reporting mods not showing up.  Since we are unable to reproduce this bug, we kindly ask that you send us the output log.

Steps:
-Make sure you have subscribed to mods.  Run the game and confirm that none are active(Bottom right corner text says how many mods are active)

-Once you have confirmed this, navigate to the output log. It's usually located as a text file 'output_log' in C:\Users\YourWindowsUsername\AppData\LocalLow\Brilliant Game Studios\UEBS2.

-Email the text file to contact@brilliantgamestudios.com


  Our bug squashing continues with this latest patch which attempts to fix both mods not showing up, and unit scaling/stats issues.  Both issues are determined to be regional based issues.   

-Fixed(hopefully) mods not showing up in game.  Issue was due to folder extensions in code not work in languages other than English.  We fixed this issue by fetching the folder locations of every installed mod directly through Steams API.

-Fixed unit scaling issues along with other stat based issues that used decimal values.  Another regional number parsing issue caused by decimal numbers using ',' instead of '.'.

Let us know if any of these issues still persist.  Hope everyone is having a great week.

notes.title: Hotfix For Workshop Mods
notes.notes:
We created a hotfix in attempt to solve some of the issues users are having.  

UPDATE: Since this hotfix we have been working on a new fix Incoming tonight or early tomorrow. We have discovered the cause for strange scaling of mod units as well as other related issues.  It appears it is caused by how decimal numbers are handled in different regions.  We are also working hard to solve the issue of mods not showing up.


-Some efforts were made to attempt fix the issue where no mods show up. (We were unable to replicate the issues here, so it's all guess work on our end)

-Error messages added to game initialization to help catch issues with mods, or other import issues that may help us debug more potential problems.

-New 'mods active' text added to bottom right of menu, to tell users how many mods were successfully imported.

-Bugs fixed with 'custom unit' mods, where they would not correctly load into the unit customizer.


Hope everyone is having a fantastic week.  Let us know if you are having any other issues.

notes.title: Update Beta V0.1.5 - Artillery, Iron Sights And More!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone.  Hope you all had a fantastic holiday and new years!  We decided to do a medium content update before diving too deep into mod support(Since this may take longer than anticipated).  We appreciate your patience and we are very excited to get this game into version 1.0! 

New Features/Content:
-New iron sights in first person mode.  Most units using guns have this feature both in sandbox and campaigns.
-New stationary powerful long range artillery unit in WW2 category.
-New 'Terrorist Puppet' unit added.
-Balance changed in invasion mode.  Some weapons buffed, and round settings changed.
-Aiming and iron sights also increase accuracy while aiming.


 Fixes:
-Death sounds for Jedi fixed(Was using 'Juice Man' death sounds).
-Bug fixed in unit editor that caused the wrong unit to be loaded in.
- reduced animation twitchiness in possession.
- possession ragdoll improved.
- spinning first-person gun fixed.
- idle animation cycling added to possession.
- basic iron sights added to FPS invasion and sandbox.

notes.title: Updated Roadmap, Mod Support, & Delayed Release
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!  We just updated the roadmap, and we are excited to show you where things are going.  Unfortunately release of version 1.0 is being delayed to sometime in the early new year.  However, the highly requested mod support is almost within reach! 

  We are excited to announce that the next update is transitioning from alpha into Beta v0.1.  After that release, mod support will officially start in full time development.  Beta v0.2 will be the first mod support update, which will be focused on character modding.  Other mod focused updates will follow.

More info on the official roadmap: https://steamcommunity.com/app/1468720/discussions/0/3279195432655300845/

Regards,

Brilliant Game Studios.

notes.title: Battle Reset Button & More! Day 2 Patch
notes.notes:
Hey everyone, we have another patch here to address some of the issues you are having.  This patch was actually released yesterday but Steam has been buggy lately and we were unable to post patch notes until today.  

-Battle reset button.  This will help with loosing armies off screen as well as being able to start from scratch.
-Performance warnings adjusted(It was getting a little carried away with large maps).
-Vsync added to menu.


We hope you have a fantastic weekend everyone!  Thanks again for your amazing support!

notes.title: Initialization Freeze/Crash Fix - Day 1 Patch
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, we are working hard to make sure this launch is as stable as possible.  The load crash bug was never something we saw until launch day and we apologize.  Here are the day one fixes.  Let us know if you have any other issues, or if you are still having the same freeze/crash.

-Fixed loading hang/crash on battle initialization (We tested on 3 different Nvida PCs).
-Added a skip option for battle initialization (This risks AI navigation not working well at the start of battle).
-Added new warning for placing armies too far apart.
-Buffed 'Noah's Flood' god power.

notes.title: UEBS2 Release Delayed, We Want This To Be Great..
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!  We want to thank you all for your continued support in our journey with this beast, Ultimate Epic Battle Simulator 2.  UEBS2 is already bigger than we ever planned, but we think we can still do better..

 We have decided to delay the release to (Hopefully early) spring of 2022.  We have been working super hard on both UEBS2 and The Black Masses.  As some of you may know, we just pushed The Black Masses to beta 0.1.  A great accomplishment for us here @ Brilliant Game Studios!  The open world title is currently on sale for 66% off, so head on over if you wish to support our other titles!

I hope everyone is having a fantastic week, we will be posting new videos soon so keep your eyes open!

Regards,

Brilliant Game Studios.
